content:
Last weekend, Apple TV made several announcements at San Diego Comic-Con, including a surprise regarding the premiere date of the fourth season of "Silo" ("Woven Sanctuary").

"Silo" season 4 will premiere in the summer of 2027 and will be the final season of the series.

"Silo" season 3 is currently airing (you can watch it here), with new episodes released weekly until September 4.

But last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, along with other sci-fi series updates, Apple brought a surprise announcement for "Silo" fans.

"Silo" season 4 will meet viewers next summer and will bring the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement posted on Apple TV's X account:

In the era of streaming platforms, it has become common for several years to pass between different seasons of a show. For high-production-cost sci-fi series like "Silo," this is even more pronounced.

However, Apple has been working to speed up the return of some of its shows by greenlighting renewals in advance. In the case of "Silo," seasons 3 and 4 were actually filmed simultaneously, shot back-to-back.

We still have six weeks of new "Silo" episodes to watch. However, once this season ends, the wait for season 4 won't be too long.

What do you think of "Silo" season 3? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and discounts are also available through the Apple One bundle.
